source.worker_visibility: public task, current artifact, and candidate tools only

phase_design.checkpoint_action: call the candidate component or state an evidence-grounded skip

causal_sequence: candidate component called at the phase checkpoint
Worker revised the artifact and ran a focused real-data smoke
Worker called the same component again and cleared all declared relations
interpretation: The phase-aware probe restored the intended low-cost causal test: it changed a late, non-actionable component call into an early call followed by edit, smoke, re-audit, and official property gain. The middleware scheduled the decision and preserved post-observation work; it did not author relation arguments, execute the audit automatically, edit the artifact, or expose official answers to the Worker.
claim_boundary: Positive seeded causal-probe result and property-level gain. It is not a fresh-Worker result, binary reward gain, repeat, protection, transfer, sealed evaluation, or end-to-end autonomous search result.
